A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the health effects of iron deficiency are more important than the potential adverse effects of iron intake at levels recommended in the NMR 4.
the health benefits of adequate iron status in infants, children, and adults outweigh the risks of adverse effects of iron intake at the recommended levels.
iron is a very important nutrient for human health.
The main takeaway from our work is that

iron deficiency and iron deficiency anemias in infants, young children and pregnant women are associated with adverse health effects, while the effects of iron intaken at levels suggested by the NRR 4 are not well established.
there is insufficient evidence to change the recommendations for iron intakes in infants, children, and adults.
